svg.aria-label: Crossover. Cleared: LEGACY × CODE: Quiet fans on an EPYC from Windows without installing tools: raw IPMI over WMI, and the low-RPM fail-safe traced in the SEL. GPU × FIRMWARE: A fan floor in the VBIOS of the blower 3090s with Vix's loader, plus a fix for the BMC's fan spikes. LLM × IRON: vLLM on four 3090s without P2P or NVLink: MoE models run 2 to 4 times faster than dense ones, and at 280 W per GPU they match 350 W. AGENTS × INFRA: Three CrewAI agents that turn requirements into Kubernetes manifests and validate them. Locked: GPU × FAB: Printed ducts so the blowers don't have to scream. IRON × ELEC: Measuring what the server draws per generated token. GPU × TRAIN: Fine-tuning on the four 3090s.
